about: Model-year evidence for the OBDb odometer and service definitions the app reads. Per vehicle (catalog make-model) and signal id: [years in which the command applies, years in which it is still being debugged, years with a recorded reply in OBDb tests]. "*" means every year. A signal that is not listed has no evidence either way.
source: OBDb vehicle repositories (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/OBDb): signalsets filter and dbgfilter and tests/test_cases. Derived by research/tools/evidence-obdb.js; credit in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
